title: coauthored: AI co-authorship trailers in AI infrastructure repositories, 2023–2026
description: Who Writes the Code That Trains the Models? coauthored counts commits that carry an explicit AI attribution (Co-authored-by trailers naming an AI tool, AI-agent bot accounts, generated-with markers) and the accompanying pre-registered study measures that share month by month in open-source AI infrastructure repositories, matched non-AI repositories and open-source coding-agent harnesses. Attribution is a lower bound; the study measures how much it hides. Repository-month aggregates only; no personal identities. Independent personal research; does not represent the views of any employer or institution. Code: Apache-2.0. Data: CC-BY-4.0.
